visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with bushy, curly dark hair and a black T-shirt featuring My Hero Academia characters stands in a brightly lit gym. He performs expressive hand movements and exaggerated facial expressions, looking directly into the camera. Behind him, a complex industrial ceiling with wire mesh and fluorescent lights is visible, alongside various weight-training machines. (2) A second male character, sporting a buzz cut and wearing a grey zip-up utility jacket adorned with Naruto insignias, enters the scene and confronts the first man. He speaks with high energy, using wide hand gestures and pointing to himself repeatedly to assert dominance. The camera maintains a medium shot, capturing their interaction amidst the gym's workout equipment. (3) A third, remarkably muscular man with reddish-orange hair enters, wearing a black Vegeta tank top. He places his massive arms around the shoulders of the other two men, who now appear much smaller and intimidated. The muscular man points to his forehead and his chest, emphasizing his status. The scene concludes with the three together in a group shot.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic skit that establishes a social hierarchy in a gym based on anime fandom and physical stature. It starts with a regular fan, progresses to a more intense fan, and culminates in the reveal of an extremely muscular professional-grade athlete who represents the 'OG' level of the subculture.
